components.label: Loss
components.onChange: return { fn: value, x: state.x0, path: [state.x0] };

components.title: Loss curve
components.onDrag: return { x0: pos.x, x: pos.x, path: [pos.x] };

components.title: Loss per step
components.draw:
const f = (x) => state.fn === 'bowl' ? x * x : 0.3 * x * x + 2 * Math.sin(2 * x);
return [line(state.path.map((x, i) => [i, f(x)]), { color: 'orange' }), points(state.path.map((x, i) => [i, f(x)]), { color: 'orange', r: 2.5 })];

components.label: Loss
components.value: return state.fn === 'bowl' ? state.x * state.x : 0.3 * state.x * state.x + 2 * Math.sin(2 * state.x);
